name: Common
speakers: Humans and most other civilized races
description: The most widely spoken language in the world, used for trade and diplomacy across all races.

name: Abyssal
description: The harsh, guttural language of the Abyss, spoken by demons and those corrupted by chaos and evil.

name: Aquan
description: A flowing, melodic language spoken by creatures of elemental water and aquatic beings.

name: Auran
description: A breathy, whispered language spoken by creatures of elemental air.

name: Celestial
description: A radiant, musical language spoken by celestial beings and those touched by heavenly power.

name: Draconic
description: One of the oldest languages, said to be the tongue of magic itself. Used by dragons and many reptilian creatures.

name: Druidic
description: A secret language known only to druids, forbidden to be taught to non-druids.

name: Dwarven
description: A sturdy, clipped language reflecting dwarven values of practicality and tradition.

name: Elven
description: A fluid, melodic language with a rich written tradition of poetry and history.

name: Giant
description: A booming language spoken by giant-kin, with simple but expressive vocabulary.

name: Gnoll
description: A guttural, barking language reflecting gnoll pack hierarchy and hunting culture.

name: Gnome
description: A quick, complex language with many terms for engineering, illusion, and jokes.

name: Goblin
description: A squeaky, fast-paced language spoken throughout goblinoid society.

name: Halfling
description: A cheerful, comfortable language full of references to food, family, and home.

name: Ignan
description: A crackling, energetic language spoken by creatures of elemental fire.

name: Infernal
description: The precise, legalistic language of the Nine Hells, filled with contractual nuance and cold authority.

name: Orc
description: A brutal, aggressive language that prizes strength and dominance.

name: Sylvan
description: The ancient tongue of the fey, full of metaphor, nature imagery, and hidden meanings.

name: Terran
description: A slow, grinding language spoken by creatures of elemental earth.

name: Undercommon
description: A trade language of the Underdark, used by diverse races that dwell beneath the surface.

name: Sahuagin
description: A harsh, clicking language of the sea devils of the deep oceans.

name: Treant
description: An extremely slow, creaking language spoken by treants, with concepts that unfold over centuries.
